Meaning: The company or manufacturer that sells the electric toothbrush
The listed selling price of the product in US dollars.
The average rating given by customers who reviewed the product, typically represented on a scale such as 1–5.
How many customers rated this product, typically a integer
Indicates whether the toothbrush can connect to a mobile application, generally through features such as Bluetooth/app integration.
A brief summary describing the main features, benefits, or functionality of the toothbrush.
A claim made by the manufacturer about the product's ability to remove dental plaque, usually compared with a manual toothbrush or another product.
Manufacturer claims related to gum health, such as helping improve gum care, reduce gum problems, or provide gentler cleaning around the gums.
The number of different brushing/cleaning modes available on the toothbrush, typically a single digit number
The URL/link to the product's detailed webpage, where users can view additional product information or purchase the product.
